question: A pipe can fill a tank in 8 hours. Another pipe can empty the filled tank in 72 hours. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, then the time (in hours) in which the tank will be one-third filled, is:
solution:
**Given:**

A pipe can fill a tank in 8 hours.

Another pipe can empty the filled tank in 72 hours.

Both pipes are opened simultaneously.

**Formula used:**

Effective rate of filling = (Rate of filling) - (Rate of emptying)

Time required to fill one-third of the tank = (1/3) / (Effective rate of filling)

**Calculations:**

Rate of filling = 1/8 tank/hour

Rate of emptying = 1/72 tank/hour

Effective rate of filling = (1/8) - (1/72)

⇒ Effective rate of filling = (9 - 1) / 72

⇒ Effective rate of filling = 8 / 72

⇒ Effective rate of filling = 1 / 9 tank/hour

So, Time required to fill one-third of the tank,

⇒ (1/3) / (1/9) = 9 / 3 = 3 hours

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
